[Gentlemen](/organisation/223)
The [Bishop of Winchester ](/person/1280)has given his permission - subject to yours - for the Readings on the Training of Children used in the [Good Words](/periodical/73) for 1891 in one number, to appear in [Mothers in Council](/periodical/82) (Wells Gardiner)[^1] Have I your permission so to use them
I remain
Yours &c
C.M.

Yonge
Editor of Mothers in Council


[^1]: The Rt.

Rev.

Anthony Wilson Thorold (1825–1895) was bishop of Winchester 1890-1895.
[^2]: Isbister published Good Words.
